# Neorgon Apps

> The catalog of the iPhone apps Neorgon makes, at https://apps.neorgon.com/,
> in Spanish. Each app has a card with its icon, where it really stands (App
> Store or TestFlight, read from the app's own release docs), screenshots
> taken from the app in the simulator, and links to its help and privacy
> policy. Apps without a site of their own keep those pages here.

## Apps

- Naninani: a Japanese reader. On the App Store (1.1.3); 1.2.0 is in review. Help and privacy: https://yomu.neorgon.com/naninani/ and https://yomu.neorgon.com/naninani/privacy/
- Amigos de Enerbot: the Energon community's member app (pass, juntas, perks, Energones). In internal TestFlight. Help and privacy, in Spanish: https://apps.neorgon.com/amigos/ and https://apps.neorgon.com/amigos/privacy/
- Pittari: finds the codes in ticket PDFs and screenshots, redraws them sharp, shows them full screen or adds them to Apple Wallet. Waiting for App Review since 2026-11-11, with build 7 in internal TestFlight; approval releases it. Support and privacy, in English: https://apps.neorgon.com/pittari/ and https://apps.neorgon.com/pittari/privacy/
- Kurukuru (Hobby Orbit): a hobby wheel, learning in steps and your own rhythms, on iPhone and Apple Watch. In internal TestFlight. Support and privacy, in English, on its own site: https://hobbyorbit.neorgon.com/kurukuru/ and https://hobbyorbit.neorgon.com/kurukuru/privacy/
- HeadPain: a headache diary with a 3D head map and a report for a doctor. In internal TestFlight. Support and privacy, in English: https://apps.neorgon.com/headpain/ and https://apps.neorgon.com/headpain/privacy/
- Enerbot Doll (it was Chokon): Enerbot as a robot doll you pose and keep on your widgets; a poke makes him react, and touches and days unlock wigs and accessories. Waiting for App Review since 2026-11-10, with build 4 in internal TestFlight. Help and privacy, in Spanish: https://apps.neorgon.com/enerbot-doll/ and https://apps.neorgon.com/enerbot-doll/privacy/

## Notes

- The help and privacy pages load no script.
- None of the apps has terms of its own; on the App Store, Apple's standard licence applies.
- Contact: support@neorgon.org (Amigos de Enerbot: contact@neorgon.com).
